$comment: Applied output of the gbp-and-local-seo agent (monthly mode). Four Google Business Profile posts for ChefScape in May 2026, one per week. Each respects GBP format limits (title ≤ 58 chars, body ≤ 1500 chars) and uses the right cta_button kind for the action.

gbp_posts.title: Mother's Day brunch — May 10, two seatings
gbp_posts.body: Three-vendor pre-fixe at the food hall, Sunday May 10. Two seatings: 10:30 AM and 12:30 PM. Walk-ins welcome for the bar and the hall floor all day, no reservation needed. Reserve a brunch seat at (703) 480-5100.
gbp_posts.image_brief: Brunch plate + mimosa half in frame, overhead. Real plate from the kitchen, not stock.

gbp_posts.title: AAPI Heritage Month — vendor feature every Friday
gbp_posts.body: Four of our hall vendors are AAPI-owned. Every Friday + Saturday in May we put one on the feature slot — their cuisine, their signature dish. This Friday: [VENDOR NAME], [CUISINE]. On the hall floor 11 AM – 10 PM. 1602 Village Market Blvd SE, Leesburg.
gbp_posts.image_brief: Single tight dish photo of [DISH NAME]. Or vendor's hands plating. Natural light, no overlay text.

gbp_posts.title: Memorial Day grill-prep class — Sat May 23, 11 AM
gbp_posts.body: Two-hour cooking class — marinades, rubs, plating, timing. Leave with three recipes and the marinades pre-made. $65 a seat. 14 seats only. Reserve at (703) 480-5100. 1602 Village Market Blvd SE, Leesburg.
gbp_posts.image_brief: Hands prepping marinades in steel bowls, or a finished grilled item from a previous class. No 'cooking instructor in apron smiling at camera' stock framing.

gbp_posts.title: Memorial Day weekend hours — open all 3 days
gbp_posts.body: Sat 5/23 · 10 AM – 10 PM. Sun 5/24 · 10 AM – 9 PM. Mon 5/25 · 10 AM – 9 PM. Two graduation-party Saturdays still open this month (May 23 and May 30). After May 30: summer pause on bookings. Reserve at (703) 480-5100.
gbp_posts.image_brief: Hall floor at a busy lunch service, soft warm light. No faces facing camera.

notes_for_operator: All four posts share the (703) 480-5100 phone CTA. If the website starts taking event bookings online, swap one or two to LEARN_MORE with the booking page URL.

The AAPI feature post will repeat the structure week-by-week; we kept ONE GBP slot for it (not four) since GBP defaults to 7-day visibility. The four weekly social posts on FB/IG handle the per-vendor specifics.
